purpose: Evaluate public Mexican fleet and vehicle-kilometer denominators for the 2024 SCIAN 4841 expense benchmark and the D2D tractor-trailer pilot.

sources.publisher: Dirección General de Autotransporte Federal, SICT
sources.title: Estadística Básica del Autotransporte Federal 2024
sources.scope: Federal public freight service; cargo general and specialized split; motor units, trailers, industrial cranes, and vehicle classes.

sources.publisher: Dirección General de Autotransporte Federal, SICT
sources.title: Estadística Básica del Autotransporte Federal 2025
sources.scope: Federal public freight service; cargo general and specialized split; motor units, trailers, industrial cranes, and vehicle classes.

sources.publisher: Dirección General de Servicios Técnicos, SICT
sources.title: Vehículos-kilómetro 2024
sources.scope: Estimated vehicle-kilometers by broad traffic class (automobiles, buses, trucks) across studied federal/state and toll/free roads.

sources.title: EAT 2024, SCIAN 4841 expenses
sources.scope: National economic-activity survey tabulation for general cargo road transport enterprises/establishments; not restricted to SICT federal permits.

limitations: EAT SCIAN 4841 and SICT federal-permit fleet have different statistical and legal populations; a shared year does not establish a valid join.
The SICT cargo-general fleet count combines motor units, trailers, and industrial cranes; these cannot all be used as an interchangeable fixed-cost denominator.
The SICT T3 and S2/S3 equipment distributions are marginal counts, not linked tractor-trailer combinations; do not infer a dominant matched combination.
SICT vehicle-kilometers are for broad truck traffic on the studied road network, not identified freight carriers, cargo-general service, equipment cohorts, or productive carrier mileage.
No public measure retrieved here gives productive days, loaded/empty mileage by the pilot segment, or annual mileage per individual fleet unit.
